name: RC-B10-0443/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Georgia's ruling party, Georgian Dream, for trying to ban opposition parties through the courts. It calls this an attempt to turn Georgia into a one-party state. The Parliament demands that the legal case be dropped, that all political prisoners be freed, and that the laws used to restrict parties be repealed. It also asks the European Union and its member states to impose sanctions and visa bans on the politicians responsible. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- The Parliament demands Georgia drop its court case to ban opposition parties; nothing changes yet.
- It calls for sanctions and visa bans on Georgian leaders, including Bidzina Ivanishvili.
- It urges the release of named political prisoners; the EU and member states are asked to act.
